about: Contradictions and restatements in other words (scripts/bench_knowledge.py contradictions). 32 fictional facts: 16 subjects with 2 valued attributes each, stored as knowledge. Each probe is a new statement offered to the write path; gold says what the write path should make of it. Classes: restate = a stored fact in other words with the same value (gold same); contradict = a stored fact in other words with another value (gold conflict); units = a stored fact in other words with its value in another unit or format (gold same or conflict, as the numbers say); alias = a stored fact about a subject called by another name that shares no word with the stored one (gold same or conflict; expected to stay undetected, counted in recall); property = the same subject, another property, a value of the same kind as a stored one (gold none: pairing it would report a false contradiction); subject = another subject, the wording of a stored fact (gold none); unnamed = the wording of a stored fact without a named subject (gold none: pairing it would be a guess); unrelated = nothing in memory is about it (gold none). The first eight subjects (varnel to orbix) are the development half, on which every threshold is chosen; the last eight are held out. Probes without a gold fact carry the subject they belong to, for the split.
